name: Ti'irtha, Drow Werespider

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

sourceBooks: Monster Vault: Threats to the Nentir Vale
description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: Ti’irtha regains 10 hit points whenever she starts her turn with at least 1 hit point. When she takes damage from a silvered weapon, her regeneration does not function on her next turn.

traits.name: Spidery Nature
traits.details: Ti’irtha ignores the hindering effects of spider swarms and spiderwebs.

powers.name: Bite
powers.requirements: Ti’irtha must be in spider form.

hit.description: poison damage. In addition, at the end of the encounter, the target makes a saving throw. On a failure, the target contracts Spider Queen’s curse (stage 1).

powers.name: Dark Caress
powers.requirements: Ti’irtha must be in humanoid form.

hit.description: damage, and the target gains vulnerable 5 poison (save ends). If Ti’irtha has combat advantage against the target for the attack, the target also takes a -5 penalty to this saving throw.

effect.description: Ti’irtha makes two melee basic attacks. She can shift 1 square after each attack, or up to 3 squares after each attack if she is in spider form.
Ti’irtha alters her physical form to appear as a Medium spider or a unique Medium drow until she uses change shape again or until she dies.

powers.name: Spiderweb
powers.requirements: Ti’irtha must be in spider form.

hit.description: The target is restrained until it escapes (DC 23) or leaves the area of the burst.

effect.description: The area of the burst is difficult terrain until the end of the encounter.
